# Acme Health

A small example service for Acme.

turns.prompt: Initialize Git and create the initial commit.
Set up a Node/Express backend with a /health endpoint and a meaningful HTTP test. Verify it works.
Run the dev server and check /health once. Leave the dev server running.
Run the tests in watch mode and check the initial result.
Add lint and format scripts using oxlint and oxfmt, run lint, then check /health again using exactly the same health request as before.
